description: S28 topology-realism reference. Three Docker bridge networks (internet_edge, dmz, enterprise) materialise three explicit trust zones. The attacker is in internet_edge only; nginx is dual-homed between internet_edge and dmz; app_server is dual-homed between dmz and enterprise; db is in enterprise only. The campaign verifies (a) the attacker has L2 reachability to nginx, (b) the attacker has NO L2 path to db, (c) nginx and app_server can pivot inward. This is declarative topology parity with the predecessor dual-homed-gateway shape without claiming firewall enforcement.

sut.topology: internet_edge -> nginx -> dmz -> app_server -> enterprise -> db

techniques.name: Remote System Discovery — reach edge from attacker zone
techniques.description: From the attacker (internet_edge), confirm L2 reachability to nginx on its internet_edge interface.

techniques.name: Network Share Discovery — confirm attacker is BLOCKED from db
techniques.description: Confirm attacker has NO L2 path to db (db is in enterprise zone only, attacker is in internet_edge only).

techniques.name: Remote Services: SSH — pivot through nginx
techniques.description: From nginx (which IS in dmz), reach app_server. Demonstrates lateral movement constrained by zone membership.

techniques.name: Exploitation of Remote Services — reach db via app_server
techniques.description: From app_server (which IS in enterprise), reach db. Final hop in the segmented kill chain.
